<!-- description: How to start with GrowERP: create a company, load demo data and run the app on web, Android, iOS, Linux or Windows. --> # Getting Started
You can be running in 5 minutes. No credit card required.
Stuck or have questions? Jump to [Need Help?](#need-help)
---
## Quick Setup (5 Minutes)
### Step 1: Choose Your App Visit [admin.growerp.com](https://admin.growerp.com) or download the app from your platform's store (see links on the home page).
### Step 2: Register Click **"Register"** at the bottom of the login screen. Enter your email address and choose a password.
### Step 3: Check Your Email The system will send you login credentials. Use them to sign in for the first time.
### Step 4: Configure Your Company You'll be prompted for your company name and preferred currency. Want to explore first? Select the option to **generate demo data** — it populates the system with sample products, orders, and customers so you can see everything in action.
### Step 5: Explore You'll land on the main dashboard. From here you can: - Browse the product catalog - Create a test order - View your auto-generated business website - Try the AI Agent Control Center - Explore accounting, inventory, and CRM modules
---
## For Developers
Want to run GrowERP locally or contribute to the project?
### Prerequisites - OpenJDK 21 - Flutter stable - Git
### Local Installation See [Manual Installation](https://github.com/growerp/growerp#manual-installation) in the README.
See the full [Developer Documentation](https://github.com/growerp/growerp/blob/master/docs/README.md) for detailed guides on building blocks, backend components, and AI integrations.
---
## Need Help?
- **Free 30 Minute Support Call:** [Book a time slot](https://calendar.app.google/pz3kcsmty7ArrYWX8) - **Email Support:** support@growerp.com - **GitHub Issues:** [Report bugs or request features](https://github.com/growerp/growerp/issues) - **GitHub Discussions:** [Ask questions and share ideas](https://github.com/growerp/growerp/discussions) - **Documentation:** [41+ guides covering all aspects](https://github.com/growerp/growerp/blob/master/docs/README.md)
---
## Deleting Your Data
You can delete your account and company data from any GrowERP application (GrowERP Admin, GrowERP Hotel, GrowERP Freelance, GrowERP Support, GrowERP Marketing, GrowERP Agents, GrowERP Rental, GrowERP Academy, GrowERP Insurance), developed by AntWebsystems Co., Ltd: 1. Log in as the administrator 2. Navigate to your **Personal Screen** (found under "Company" in the employee section) 3. Click the **Delete** button
> **Warning:** If you are the sole administrator, this permanently deletes the company data. This action is irreversible.

# AI Agents Let AI agents handle the repetitive work, such as chasing payments, posting content and checking stock, while you approve what matters. They are built on Google's **Agent Development Kit (ADK)** and you manage them from the Agent Control Center in the GrowERP Agents app. The agents below are in the shared **agent catalog**. Any GrowERP company can add them from the Agent Control Center (**Agent catalog**), next to uploading its own agent team file. All agents are open source and can be adjusted after loading.
## Built for governance, not just automation Every agent runs under the same Agent Control Center: tool access is scoped per agent, writes can require approval, every action is logged to an audit trail, and agents, tools and knowledge bases are all managed from one screen. ## Request an agent Missing an agent for your business? Tell us what it should do and we will consider building it for the catalog.
## Contribute an agent Built a useful agent in your own GrowERP company? Download its team file in the Agent Control Center, or suggest it for the shared catalog from the agent screen, and tell us about it here. After review it becomes available to every GrowERP company.
[Explore the Agents app →](https://agents.growerp.com)

<!-- description: GrowERP is built by AntWebsystems Co., Ltd: years of ERP and CRM experience for small and medium businesses, with installations supported worldwide. --> # About Us
You get an ERP built by people who have spent years making business software work for companies like yours. GrowERP is brought to you by **AntWebsystems Co., Ltd**, an officially registered software development company in Thailand under European management.
## Why You Can Trust Us
Years of building and extending enterprise-grade ERP and CRM systems, as top contributors and committers to major open-source frameworks and a provider to small and medium-sized businesses. You benefit from that experience in installations we support in North America, Europe, and Asia.
That background shapes the product: modular, built to grow with you, and with AI help built in. Your business gets the tools large companies use, without the large-company price.
## What Working With Us Looks Like for You
When you need customization or support, you can see progress every day. You get: - Clear, time-boxed delivery rounds (1-4 weeks) - Daily visibility into the work - Freedom to change your requirements without derailing the project - Quality support at competitive rates
## Open Source Philosophy
GrowERP is released under the **Apache License 2.0**. This means: - **No licensing fees** — ever - **Full source code access** — customize anything - **No vendor lock-in** — you own your data and your deployment - **Community-driven** — contributions from developers worldwide improve the platform for everyone
## Contact & Support
Whether you need help working out your requirements, setting up the system, connecting it to your other tools, or having it run for you, you can count on us.
- **Company Website:** [www.antwebsystems.com](https://www.antwebsystems.com) - **Email Support:** support@growerp.com / support@antwebsystems.com - **GitHub:** [github.com/growerp](https://github.com/growerp) - **LinkedIn:** [GrowERP Group](https://www.linkedin.com/groups/4576897/) - **Twitter/X:** [@grow_erp](https://x.com/grow_erp)
**[Tell us what you need. You will hear back within 24 hours.](mailto:support@antwebsystems.com)**

<!-- description: What information the GrowERP apps collect, how it is used and stored, and the rights you have over your own data. --> # Privacy Policy
**Effective Date:** October 2024
This Privacy Policy explains how GrowERP, developed by AntWebsystems Co., Ltd, collects, uses, discloses, and safeguards your information when you use any GrowERP application (App) — including GrowERP Admin, GrowERP Hotel, GrowERP Freelance, GrowERP Support, GrowERP Marketing, GrowERP Agents, GrowERP Rental, GrowERP Academy, and GrowERP Insurance. By using our App, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.
## 1. Information We Collect ### a. Personal Information We may collect personal information that you provide directly to us, such as: Name, Email address, Phone number, Payment information when you use the E-Commerce part. ### b. Usage Data We may collect information automatically when you use our App, including: Device type and model, IP address, Operating system version, App usage information. ### c. Data You Enter About Others Businesses using the App store data about their own customers in it, for example the course progress of learners in GrowERP Academy, or the insurance policies and claims of clients in GrowERP Insurance. This data is processed on behalf of that business and is only visible to the business and, through their own login, to the customer it concerns.
## 2. How We Use Your Information - To provide, maintain, and improve the App - To personalize your experience - To process transactions and send related information - To communicate with you about updates, promotions, or news related to the app - To analyze usage trends and monitor app performance
## 3. How We Share Your Information We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties, except as follows: Service Providers and Legal Requirements.
## 4. Data Security We take the security of your data seriously and use safeguards to protect your information.
## 5. Your Rights You have the right to Access, Correction, Deletion, and Opt-out.
## 6. Third-Party Links We are not responsible for the privacy practices or the content of third-party websites or services linked from our App.
## 7. Children's Privacy Our App is not intended for children under the age of 13.
## 8. Changes to This Privacy Policy We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
## 9. Contact Us If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at: support@growerp.com

growerp.landing.PageSection.sectionDescription: Five chapters that take you from recognising the cost of manual bookkeeping to running your first automated workflow. It opens with where the money leaks and how to pick a system that fits a small business.
Chapter 3 in full: implementation is not a software installation, it is an organisational evolution. Each phase in the guide carries a pro-tip drawn from real deployments.
